description: The Tree Supply Report 2025 analyses how many tree saplings British nurseries expected to have ready for sale in the 2024-25 season, by species and by nursery, with comparison to earlier years. The Forestry Commission collected the data between August 2024 and January 2025 from 16 large private forest nurseries and 2 public nurseries in England, Scotland and Wales, which it estimates grow over 90 percent of saplings used for forest and woodland planting. Coverage is Great Britain; the report finds 161 million saplings and 125 species, with Sitka spruce above 72 million. Format and access: an open HTML report with charts and a species appendix, free to read under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Caveats: figures rely on sample extrapolation and predicted output, not counts or sales, are production not availability or demand, and amenity, urban planting, Christmas trees and hedging are outside the survey scope. It supports resilience and climate adaptation studies of woodland and nature-based planting programmes, where sapling supply limits how fast planting targets can be met. No related record in the catalogue covers nursery supply; a nearby one is the High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forests.
